products.name: SOC Onboarding — Microsoft Sentinel + Defender XDR Unified Incidents — Commercial
products.short_description: One incident queue for the whole SOC — unify Microsoft Sentinel and Defender XDR so analysts work one prioritized list.
products.description:
One incident queue for the whole SOC — unify Microsoft Sentinel and Defender XDR so analysts work one prioritized list.

Running Sentinel and Defender XDR as two consoles means duplicated incidents and missed correlation. This solution connects Defender XDR to Sentinel, unifies the incident queue, aligns severity and ownership, and gives analysts one triage workflow across identity, endpoint, email, and cloud.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Defender XDR ↔ Sentinel integration and incident sync
  • Unified incident queue with de-duplication and correlation
  • Severity, priority, and ownership alignment across both
  • Analyst triage workflow and shift/hand-off runbook
  • RBAC and workspace scoping for the SOC team

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A single, correlated incident queue that ends console-hopping and speeds every investigation.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • SOCXDR-Discovery.ps1 — readiness for unifying Microsoft Sentinel + Defender XDR incidents
    • SOCXDR-IncidentQueue.ps1 — incident-queue health across severity, owner, and tags
    • SOCXDR-Report.ps1 — duplicate-rule status and the open-incident shift hand-off list
    • SOCXDR-Set-SocRbacScope.ps1 — report and (optionally) apply the scoped SOC RBAC on the workspace
    • SOCXDR-Validate.ps1 — confirm the Defender XDR connector is connected and incidents are arriving

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
